name: Great tit
lateFeature: Cream double wing bar, dark primaries and central breast stripe
anatomyNotes: Large black cap and white cheek identify the head. Yellow breast tapers into dark keel stripe; long blue tail is separate from compact body. Wing bars receive meaningful late work.
